title: GPUs and AI servers: what to choose, and why?
subtitle: Compare accelerators and servers, check software support and assess performance per cost, based on real workloads.

intro: Start with the workload: the model's memory requirements, numerical format, communication pattern and service targets. Use the tables to compare hardware, then follow the guides to assess software compatibility, host resources and the full cost of deployment.
startIntro: Begin with the work the system needs to do. The tables help you compare options; the articles explain what the differences mean. Choose the path that matches your decision.
